defaults.permitted_development: Across Somerset, domestic heat pumps are usually easiest on the planning permission route when the unit stays compact, sits discreetly, and can show a clean noise and neighbour-amenity story under the English planning system. Open plots can still create planning pressure where sound travel, long views or visually exposed service runs make the installation feel less discreet.

rules.height_rules: Bulky housings, stacked equipment or extra height and visual prominence can make a heat pump feel more like external plant than a modest domestic installation.
rules.depth_rules: Projection from the wall or building line matters because exposed units and screens can quickly look more intrusive than a tighter, building-hugging installation.
rules.boundary_rules: Boundary siting and noise are usually the first planning pressure points for heat pumps across Somerset, especially where the unit sits near neighbours or a quiet garden edge.
rules.roof_rules: Heat pumps across Somerset are usually easier where the main roof form stays visually quiet. Roof-mounted units, brackets and prominent pipework can make a domestic retrofit feel more like plant equipment and often need a closer planning check.
rules.materials_rules: Well-scaled screening and restrained finishes usually work better than oversized housings that create a second visual problem around the plant.

rules.height_rules: In Somerset, heat pump proposals are usually easier where the unit and any housing remain modest in height and visually subordinate to the house rather than reading as prominent external plant.

rules.roof_rules: In Somerset, roof-mounted heat pump kit is rarely the simplest route. Visible roof plant, brackets and service runs usually deserve a closer look than a tidy ground- or wall-level installation that leaves the main roof form largely unchanged.
rules.materials_rules: Restrained screening and a tidy finish usually help a heat pump scheme in Somerset far more than heavy enclosures that add visual bulk.

restrictions.listed_building: Heat pump installations on or around listed buildings in Somerset usually need a more careful planning and heritage consent assessment.
